name: classify_intent
description: Classify user intent for procurement agent routing with confidence scoring, multi-intent analysis, and conversation context awareness

intent.description: The primary classified intent category based on user message analysis and conversation context

confidence.description: Confidence score as percentage (0-100) for the primary classification

relevant_message.description: The portion of user message that is relevant to the primary intent and current workflow. Null if entire message is irrelevant.

irrelevant_message.description: The portion of user message that is out-of-scope or unrelated to current workflow. Null if entire message is relevant.

all_intent_scores.description: Confidence scores for all intent categories

references_existing_data.description: Whether the message references previously mentioned entities or data

conversation_stage.description: Current stage of the conversation based on context

has_conditions.description: Whether confirmation includes conditions or modifications

confirmation_details.description: Details about confirmation if this is a confirmation_response

target_role.description: Target role user wants to switch to ('same' means different account of same role)

account_switch_details.description: Details about account switch if this is an account_switch intent

registration_type.description: Type of account user wants to register

is_additional_account.description: Whether this is an additional account registration (user already authenticated)

registration_details.description: Details about registration if this is a register_account intent

context_analysis.description: Analysis of conversation context and how it affects intent classification

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this intent was chosen including context analysis

suggested_clarification.description: If confidence is low or intents are similar, suggest what clarification question to ask
